plugins.name: ihateposting
plugins.description: Draft, check, schedule and publish posts to 14 social networks from Claude: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Tumblr and Slack. It works through the hosted iHatePosting MCP server; you sign in with your iHatePosting account, and there is no API key to paste.

skills.name: ihateposting
skills.description: Draft, check, schedule and publish social posts through the iHatePosting MCP server, drafts by default, to 14 networks (Bluesky, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Tumblr, Slack). Use when the user asks to post, schedule, draft, reschedule or retry a post, or asks how posts did.
headings: Rule one: nothing goes live unless the user said so
